newsitem.title: USA: Skyline Chili says gets unsolicited offer.
newsitem.headline: Skyline Chili says gets unsolicited offer.

text.p: Skyline Chili Inc said Friday that it recently received an unsolicited offer from an unaffiliated third party to acquire or gain control of the company.
The offer contained several alternatives, each with a price of about $7.50 per share. Some of those alternatives were directed solely to the company's majority shareholders, it said.

Skyline said all of the alternatives could result in its minority shareholders receiving securities of the acquirer. The company's majority shareholders have rejected the alternatives, deeming them inadequate in price and structure.
Skyline's board of directors has formed a special committee to evaluate the remaining portions of the offer with its financial and legal advisers.
